body.name: Ordered Green sign handle
body.construction: Apply the adjacent-mass \(LDL^{\top}\) factorization of the bridge kernel \(K_{\Pi}\), followed by Cauchy--Binet expansions of the minors of \(G(\Pi)\) and the numerators \(h_{t,\ell}(\Pi)\), to derive a sign-and-zero rule for the entries of \(L(\Pi)\).
